actions.description: Create an Instagram publishing container for an image, video, reel, or carousel item.
actions.name: create-media-container

ig_user_id.description: Instagram professional account ID (the user_id from get-account) to create the container for. Omit to use the authenticated account (/me). Pass the same value to publish-media-container. Example: "17841446782016736"

image_url.description: Public URL of a JPEG image to upload. Required for image posts and image carousel items.

video_url.description: Public URL of a video to upload. Required for video, reel, and video carousel item containers.

media_type.description: Container type. Use REELS or STORIES for those formats, VIDEO for a feed video, and CAROUSEL for a carousel parent. Defaults to IMAGE when image_url is provided.

caption.description: Caption for the media. Not supported for carousel child containers or stories.

alt_text.description: Alternative text for accessibility on image posts.

is_carousel_item.description: Set to true when this container is an item in a carousel; the parent CAROUSEL container references its ID.

children.description: Ordered container IDs of the carousel items. Required when media_type is CAROUSEL.

items.description: Media container ID of a carousel item. Example: "18064105307559401"

location_id.description: Instagram location page ID to tag in the media. Example: "213385402"

user_tags.description: Instagram users to tag in the media, each with a username and normalized x/y position.

username.description: Instagram username to tag, without the @ symbol. Example: "nangodev"

x.description: Horizontal position of the tag relative to the image width, typically between 0 and 1. Example: 0.5

y.description: Vertical position of the tag relative to the image height, typically between 0 and 1. Example: 0.5

collaborators.description: Instagram usernames to invite as collaborators on the post.

items.description: Instagram username of a collaborator. Example: "nangodev"

cover_url.description: Public URL of an image to use as the reel cover. Applies to reels only.

thumb_offset.description: Offset in milliseconds of the video frame to use as the thumbnail. Applies to videos and reels.

share_to_feed.description: Whether a reel should also appear in the account feed.

audio_name.description: Name to display for the audio used in a reel.

is_ai_generated.description: Set to true to self-disclose that the media was generated with AI.

ActionInput_instagram_createmediacontain.description: Parameters for creating an Instagram publishing container for an image, video, reel, story, or carousel.

id.description: ID of the created media container. Pass it to the publish-media-container action to publish it. Example: "18064105307559401"

uri.description: Resumable upload URI returned for resumable video uploads. Example: "https://rupload.facebook.com/ig-api-upload/v26.0/18064105307559401"

ActionOutput_instagram_createmediacontai.description: The created Instagram media container ID and optional resumable upload URI.

actions.description: Retrieve account-level insights for an Instagram business or creator account.
actions.name: get-user-insights

metric.description: Comma-separated metric names to retrieve. Example: "reach,profile_views"

period.description: Aggregation period for the metrics. Example: "day"

since.description: Start of the time range as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Defaults to the last 24 hours.

until.description: End of the time range as a Unix timestamp in seconds. Defaults to the current time.

timeframe.description: Preset timeframe required by demographic metrics. Overrides since and until for those metrics.

metric_type.description: How to aggregate results: "time_series" for values per period, or "total_value" for a single total with optional breakdowns.

breakdown.description: Breakdown dimension for metrics that support it. Example: "media_product_type"

breakdowns.description: Plural breakdown dimension used by demographic metrics. Example: "country"

period.description: Aggregation period returned for the metric. Example: "day"

description.description: Description of what the metric measures.

id.description: Provider identifier for the metric query.

values.description: Values per period when using time-series aggregation.

end_time.description: End of the period in ISO 8601 format.

total_value.description: Single total value when using total-value aggregation.

value.description: Total aggregated metric value across the requested range.

breakdowns.description: Breakdown results for the total value.

dimension_keys.description: Breakdown dimensions included in the results.

dimension_values.description: Values for each requested breakdown dimension.

value.description: Metric value for this breakdown set.

end_time.description: End of the period for this breakdown set in ISO 8601 format.

data.description: Insights returned for each requested metric.

paging.description: Pagination links when the provider returns them.

previous.description: URL for the previous page of results.

next.description: URL for the next page of results.
